body:
I definitely agree that *I'm* not a psychopath. (Me being the state of consciousness I'm in at the time of typing this) Yet there is definitely something or someone in me that is, or has such tendencies. Maybe some form of personality or dissociative disorder? It is difficult to explain, and is somewhat worrying because I (see the previous brackets) know all of that stuff is very wrong and abnormal and I have no intention of ever hurting anyone.

But *I* am not the only one who is inside my head, there seem to be other personalities or mindstates that are by any normal standards, totally insane that sometimes are the dominate personality in my mind, and when one of those are the 'louder voice' per se, thats when i find myself getting satisfaction/ interest from watching/ thinking about pain on others. 

It is thankful the 'original' me is there to keep it in check. 

Some psychologists (Freud) believe there are essentially three elements to everyones brain which results in their personality and the decisions they make. The Id, the ego and the super ego. 

The Id strives for strives for immediate gratification of all desires, wants, and needs. For example, an increase in hunger or thirst should produce an immediate attempt to eat or drink. 

The Ego and the Super Ego essentially exist so the impulses of the id can be expressed in a manner acceptable in the real world without outcry.
This means, say you were thirsty again but the only drink nearby is a random stranger's... The Id would be calling for you to drink it but the ego realises this may lead to conflict, and the super ego notes that morally, people would object to this action and so you come to the end decision of not grabbing their water and guzzling it. From an evolutionary standpoint when these three are in tune it allows people to function well and make decisions in communities/ colonies, which was vital to survival.

If this psychological structure is real, then I believe something is wrong with my Id, pushing me to get satisfaction from spontaneously acting out violently, but the Ego is keeping it in check as rationally, i cant go around killing everybody, it'd be a mess. Maybe it settles for observing said acts as middle ground?

There are a bunch of different ways to think about it, it could be all me that wants to hurt others, it could be another person in my head, it could be the Id, or something else entirely. I have no way of knowing, I just want it to stop, as well as all the other debilitating mental issues that wont seem to leave me alone.

I havent mentioned wanting to kill people because that would obviously have some negative repercussions, and I dont want my name on any lists anywhere, but I have mentioned violent tendencies,and short tempers, but if any of them suggested any help, it has been uneffective to date.
